name: DC barrel jack 5.5 / 2.1 mm
summary: Threaded panel-mount power socket. Needs an 8 mm round hole.
source: The common threaded panel-mount barrel jack for a 5.5 mm outer / 2.1 mm inner plug. The threaded barrel is 8 mm across, so the panel needs an 8 mm hole and a nut on the inside. The 5.5/2.1 plug size itself is standard; the body length behind the panel varies by a couple of millimetres between suppliers.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and cable

electrical.note: Rated around 5 A, but the thin solder tags are usually the weak point well before that.
